text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — gen-queue high 5xxs and tail latency spike in us-west. Auto-escalation to oncall.
oncall-alex: Acknowledged, I'm on call. Pulling logs and traces now.
sre-maya: I see spike starting at 13:02 UTC. Error rate concentrated on model shard 3, memory OOMs on fastgen workers.
oncall-alex: Repro steps and immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic away from shard 3 to fallback variant 2) restart pod pool for shard 3 with reduced batch_size. I'll start traffic reroute.
ops-bot: Reroute initiated: routing policy -> fallback-variant-2; expected change ~30s.
comms-zoe: Need a short status page initial note. Drafting below, please review for customer-facing copy.
comms-zoe: ```
Initial update (13:05 UTC): We are investigating increased error rates and latency affecting text generation in the us-west region. Some requests may return 5xx or experience longer response times. We have routed traffic to a fallback model variant to reduce errors and are actively restarting affected workers. We will post updates every 15 minutes or as the situation changes.
Affected services: Generation API (text generation) — us-west only
Customer impact: Elevated 5xx errors and slowed responses for a portion of requests. No customer data modifications observed so far.
Next update: 13:20 UTC
``` 
product-lin: Looks fine, minimal edits: add guidance for customers using dedicated capacity — can we confirm they are unaffected if pinned elsewhere?
oncall-alex: Confirmed dedicated pools pinned elsewhere are not affected. Added note: "Dedicated capacity pinned to other regions should be unaffected." 
legal-jordan: Quick review: avoid implying SLA breach. Suggest "No customer data modifications observed so far" instead of stronger language.
comms-zoe: Updated draft incorporating edits. Ready to publish once SRE confirms mitigation progress.
sre-maya: Reroute shows 70% reduction in 5xx within 2 minutes. Worker restarts in progress, pod health is turning green.
oncall-alex: Publishing initial status page now. I'll coordinate the publish window and set the ticker to "Investigating".
ops-bot: Statuspage publish API called: publish_id=sp-pub-7783, state=investigating.
comms-zoe: Published. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/7783
product-lin: Pushed a short customer note for the dashboard banner: "We are investigating elevated generation errors in us-west; follow status.redwood.ai for updates." Please keep it high level.
comms-zoe: Will post the banner as requested.
oncall-alex: Update (13:20 UTC): 5xx rate down to baseline for most traffic; tail latency still elevated for long responses. Continuing restarts and monitoring. ETA for full restoration ~20–30 minutes.
comms-zoe: Drafting follow-up update for status page.
comms-zoe: ```
Update (13:20 UTC): Mitigation underway. Traffic has been routed to a fallback variant which has reduced error rates by ~70%. We are performing controlled restarts of affected workers and monitoring latency. Some long-running requests may still experience delays.
Next update: 13:35 UTC
``` 
legal-jordan: Approve.
sre-maya: At 13:33 UTC we've observed error rates near normal, latency trending down. Decreasing autoscale threshold to avoid large batch OOMs during spin-up.
oncall-alex: Starting final validation sweep. If no regressions in next 5m we'll resolve.
comms-zoe: Preparing resolved message copy.
comms-zoe: ```
Resolved (13:40 UTC): The issue affecting text generation in the us-west region has been resolved. Error rates and latency have returned to normal levels following traffic rerouting and worker restarts. We continue to monitor the environment and will follow up with a root cause analysis.
Customer guidance: If you still see errors, try re-sending requests or reach out to support with request IDs.
``` 
ops-bot: Statuspage update called: publish_id=sp-pub-7783, state=resolved, time=13:40 UTC.
oncall-alex: Closing the pager, moving to post-incident RCA. Thanks team :tada:
comms-zoe: Publishing resolved banner and sending brief to customers who reported incidents.
product-lin: Adding an internal note to track quantization changes rolled last deploy as possible factor.
sre-maya: I'll gather logs and KV cache metrics for RCA.
legal-jordan: Keep me looped if customer claims escalate.
comms-zoe: Filed incident summary draft for the ops postmortem doc and added links to status page updates.
